profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer at CarMax
profile.summary: Experienced senior full stack software engineer looking to build cloud-native applications with a great engineering team.  Highly proficient in .NET application design & development, web applications, relational database design & cloud deployments.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description: Support asset protection and fraud initiatives at CarMax.
positions.insights: Skills: REST API · Microsoft Azure · .NET Core

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Served on a great Agile product team with some of the best team members you could ask for. My time was dedicated to enhancing the customer onboarding experience, increasing onboarding velocity and simplicity for Olo's customers. Worked closely with customers, Product, Design, and engineering manager to plan and implement user-focused features. Conducted detailed code reviews and testing of pull requests from team members and others across the organization. Practiced Whole Team Quality processes, promoting a shared responsibility for quality and a culture of continuous improvement. Supported Incident Management and conducted incident retrospectives as needed to share learnings with other team members. Shared Scrum Master responsibilities on a rotating basis each sprint, leading Agile ceremonies (planning, standup, demo, retro). Assumed role of Feature Owner for four major team initiatives, improving the performance of applications and onboarding UX.

Aside from my primary team responsibilities, I served on the production Platform Release team on a rotating basis, performing multiple platform deployments daily. I'm also proud of my work on the Olo for Good Equity Committee, sharing the responsibility of overseeing the distribution of over $7 million in charitable grants to non-profits supporting the Olo for Good mission, helping Olo meet its Pledge 1% commitment.
positions.insights: Skills: Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Agile Application Development · C#

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer for Intellinet
positions.description: Worked with team on user interface and process efficiency improvements for Walmart Connexus Pharmacy System. Participated in group deep-dive sessions of existing applciation, participated in and lead some feature design sessions, created and presented technical specification documents for client approval, navigated Walmart's software development processes with minimal guidance from client, gave feature demonstration to client, and lead development effort on a critical feature saving Walmart pharmacy workers ~30,000,000 clicks and tens of thousands of hours of worker time annually.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineering Consultant for Ursim Consulting
positions.description: Created permanent, interactive, immersive marketing experience for SunTrust Bank at The Battery at SunTrust Park in Atlanta serving tens of thousands of guests annually. The experience is comprised of multiple baseball / Atlanta Braves-themed kiosk and game experiences at The onUp Experience. Experiences include Guest Registration with marketing opt-in and printed photo badge, Financial Trivia Contest, Custom Green Screen Photo Experience, Interactive Photo Gallery, SunTrust Financial Confidence quizzes and social media experiences. Photos are made available for social media sharing on retrieval website.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer & Architect for Canopy Workforce Solutions
positions.description: Developed features, performed maintenance, documented processes, troubleshooted & supported customers of SaaS HR management & timekeeping applications. Developed and deployed mobile app API accessing legacy HR system. Optimized SQL Server queries to overcome architecture-related performance & scaling challenges. Lead development with multiple remote teammates in India, Argentina, Florida & Portugal. Collaborated with customers, product, sales, support and implementation for customer success.

positions.title: Software Consultant for B2B Technologies
positions.description: Migrated Mohawk Industries’ marketing, sales websites & databases from dedicated hosting environment to Azure cloud environment. Created design of online form submittal system for Ball State University, integrating with Oracle backend and existing custom forms designer.

positions.title: Senior Software Consultant for Phix Solutions
positions.description: Supported online marketing for Sandestin Golf & Beach Resort. Migrated hosting from CentOS Linux to Ubuntu Linux within Amazon Web Services (AWS) hosting environment. Implemented automated backup and restore process for web environment and MySQL database. Built out new site features, implemented new features for content management system (October CMS).

positions.title: Senior Software Architect for Ursim Consulting
positions.description:
Built fully integrated solutions for event marketing, including photography applications, interactive display kiosks, interactive trivia stations, mobile apps, field data collection systems, websites, desktop applications, server applications, web service applications and completely custom hardware / software integration for marketing events. Millions of consumer photos captured and shared through social media with systems I designed and built.

Built and maintained photo marketing system that captured millions of consumer event photos in the field in over 100 countries and shared them through social media for supporting top brand initiatives for Coca-Cola (Olympic Torch Tours 2014, 2012, 2010, 2008, FIFA World Cup World Tour 2014, FIFA Women’s Cup 2015), Wheat Thins (Bonnaroo Music Festival / 2010, 2011), ESPN, Cheetos, Delta, Vans Warped Tour, Make Up For Ever (2016).

Created custom marketing solutions (including hardware / software integrations) for Vodafone, Verizon Wireless (NFL Sports Marketing 2010-2013, Superbowl XLV), Motorola (Consumer Electronics Show / Las Vegas 2009, Mobile World Congress / Barcelona 2009).

Created consumer mobile payment platform for smartphones for startup client (2010-2012). Payment system allowed consumers to securely pay for goods in store with one-time use QR code on mobile phone and accumulate rewards for consumers.

positions.title: Owner, Consultant
positions.description: Designed consumer medical portal SaaS for payers for The Staywell Company. Integrated features included pharmacy refill scheduler, EMR access, drug interaction tool, and healthcare conditions and procedures content. Developed content publishing platform for medical publisher, Greystone.net. Content tagged with ICD-9 and MeSH codes, authored by onsite medical publishing staff and published to client format specifications.

positions.title: Technology Lead
positions.description: Lead technology solution development for clients at Internet software development shop. Clients included dotcom startups in addition to well-known companies including Publix Grocery Stores, SunTrust Bank (Trusco Capital), West Legal Publishing, Wyndham Hotels, Ritz-Carlton Hotels, and others. Responsible for entire solution delivery including design, implementation, hosting and support when applicable.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Developed websites and integrated custom software for large brands including Coca-Cola, Bank of America / Nationsbank, Kimberly-Clark, and Publix Grocery Stores.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Information Services Leadership Program.  Responsible for continued development and support of departmental applications and intranet.
